learning.summary_zh: George 一家到貴州三生洞探洞；教練 Jojo 一路牽著調皮的 George。他兩次跳進泥坑、飛拉達爬太快差點滑倒被 Jojo 拉住；糖果約定後學會當 careful explorer，回飯店宣布長大要娶 Jojo。
focus_en: Cave words: cave, helmet, headlamp, stalactite
Safety words: slippery, rope, harness, be careful
Key phrases: Hold my hand. I've got you. One step at a time.
tutor_prompts_zh: 問：教練 Jojo 為什麼回頭？（Mummy 喊 George 的暱稱 Jojo，教練以為在叫她）
問：George 在岩壁上發生什麼事？（爬太快滑倒，安全繩拉住、Jojo 抓住 harness）
問：Jojo 的糖果約定是什麼？（像 careful cave explorer 一樣小心走就給糖）
問：大鐘乳石像什麼？（睡著的龍）
問：回飯店後 George 宣布什麼？（他愛 Jojo，長大要娶她）

pages.alt: The family in helmets and headlamps at the cave entrance; George holds Daddy's hand

lines.text: One summer day, George and his family came to Sansheng Cave.
Everyone put on a helmet, a bright little headlamp and yellow rain boots.
Look at the dark cave mouth, George. Are you ready?
I'm scared. Hold my hand, Daddy!

pages.alt: Mummy calls out to George; Coach Jojo turns around in surprise, then takes George's hand

lines.text: Jojo! Look out! Be careful!
Oh! I thought you were calling me!
Our son is George. Sometimes we call him Jo or Jojo.
Then Coach Jojo took George's hand and looked after him.

pages.alt: Jojo leads George by the hand through the dark slippery cave lit only by headlamps

lines.text: Inside, the cave was dark, wet and very slippery.
Only their headlamps made little roads of light on the rocks.
Hold my hand, George. The mud is very slippery here.
Squish, squish! The mud is singing under my boots!

pages.alt: George jumps into a big muddy puddle with a splash while Jojo reaches out too late

lines.text: Then George saw a big brown puddle of mud.
A muddy puddle! I love muddy puddles!
SPLASH! He jumped in before Jojo could pull him back.
Oh no, George! You are a naughty boy!

pages.alt: George tugs Jojo to the puddle's edge and jumps in again; Jojo stays on the edge

lines.text: Jojo held George's hand tight, but George was quick.
He tugged her to the puddle's edge and jumped again!
Ha ha! Muddy puddle. I wanna play!
You are faster than a little frog! Slow down, the rocks are slippery!

pages.alt: A dark river blocks the path; Jojo clips George's safety rope onto the steel cable

lines.text: Soon a dark river blocked the path in the cave.
Now they had to climb along the rock wall, like real explorers.
Click! Your safety rope is clipped on. Stay close to me.
I am a cave explorer!

pages.alt: George's boot slips on the wet rock; the rope holds and Jojo grabs his harness

lines.text: George climbed faster and faster on the wet rock.
Then his boot slipped — "Whoa!" — but the rope held, and Jojo held his harness.
I've got you, George. Slow steps, one at a time.
My heart went bump! Thank you, Jojo.

pages.alt: On a wide rock ledge Jojo kneels and shows George a little candy in her palm

lines.text: On a wide rock ledge, Jojo took a little candy from her pocket.
Walk like a careful cave explorer, and this candy is yours.
I promise! Careful steps, like a cave explorer.
After that, George walked slowly and watched every step.

pages.alt: Headlamps light a huge hall of stalactites; one big stalactite looks like a sleeping dragon

lines.text: Their lamps lit up a huge hall of strange, beautiful rocks.
Stalactites hung from the roof like a stone forest.
Look! That big one looks like a sleeping dragon!
Good eyes, George! And you are walking so carefully now.

pages.alt: Snack time on little folding chairs in the cave; Jojo gives George the candy and George holds chocolate

lines.text: They sat down on little chairs for a snack, deep inside the cave.
Here is your candy, my careful explorer.
And I choose chocolate too! Two treats in one day!
George ate happily, with a little mud still on his nose.

pages.alt: George and Daddy in bright life vests paddle on a board on the glassy dark green river

lines.text: Last of all, it was time to paddle on the dark green river.
George sat on a big board in a bright life vest.
Bye-bye, cave! Bye-bye, sleeping dragon!
Then the family walked out into the warm, bright sunshine.

pages.alt: In the warm hotel room George is tucked up in bed; Mummy sits beside him and the family smiles

lines.text: Back at the hotel that night, George was tucked up in bed.
Did you like the cave, George? Do you like Jojo?
Yes! I love Jojo! I want to marry her!
Everyone laughed out loud, and George dreamed of the cave all night.

quiz.q: Why did Coach Jojo turn around?
options: She heard a noise in the cave
Mummy called "Jojo" and the coach thought she meant her

quiz.q: What was the cave like inside?
What did George jump into first?
What happened on the wet rock wall?
options: George's boot slipped, but the rope held
Walk carefully and the candy is yours
Sing a song for the candy

quiz.q: What did the big stalactite look like?
What snack did George choose at the tea break?
What did they do on the dark green river?
What did George say about Jojo at the hotel?
options: He never wants to see caves again
He loves Jojo and wants to marry her
